validity.reason: The Transformers cache simulator cloned only tensor-valued cache attributes; under transformers 5.16.x (installed by the cache notebooks) linear-attention conv/recurrent state lives in dict attributes updated in place, so the source and packed decode passes shared and corrupted that state and every K/V code width produced the same next-token KL (~0.5-0.9).
validity.evidence: Real Qwen3.5-4B, CPU bf16, prompt 256, source weights: fixed simulator gives K8/V8 KL 5.0e-4 / 3.6e-4, K4/V4 6.3e-3 / 6.9e-3, K2/V2 6.5e-2; the defective simulator under transformers 5.16.1 gives 0.877 at K8/V8 and 0.891 at K4/V4.
